en.headline: Arts in the Park returns to Causeway Bay with fairy-tale parades this weekend
en.dek: The free outdoor youth arts festival organised by the Hong Kong Youth Arts Foundation runs on 14 and 15 November, featuring giant puppets and night and finale parades.
body: Standard Chartered Arts in the Park returns to Causeway Bay this weekend for its largest edition to date, the Hong Kong Youth Arts Foundation said.

The free event takes place on 14 and 15 November at Victoria Park and surrounding streets, themed around classic fairy tales. It includes interactive art booths, live performances, storytelling in English and Cantonese, African drumming workshops and an exhibition of more than 900 artworks.

An illuminated night parade starts at 8:30pm on Saturday from the Lee Garden One area, featuring five giant lantern puppets and 18 carnival costumes. The grand finale parade begins at 2:30pm on Sunday in Victoria Park, with ten four-metre-tall puppets and about 500 young performers.
Admission is free. The Hong Kong Tourism Board listed the event among its current highlights for the weekend.

zh.headline: 藝術在公園本周末重臨銅鑼灣 童話主題遊行登場
zh.dek: 香港青年藝術協會舉辦的免費戶外青年藝術節於11月14及15日舉行，設巨型木偶及夜間與壓軸遊行。
body: 渣打銀行藝術在公園本周末重臨銅鑼灣，香港青年藝術協會表示今屆是歷來規模最大的一屆。
免費活動於11月14及15日在維多利亞公園及周邊街道舉行，以經典童話為主題。活動包括互動藝術攤位、現場表演、中英文講故事、非洲鼓工作坊及逾900件藝術品展覽。
周六晚上8時30分由利園一期一帶出發的夜間遊行，有五隻巨型燈籠木偶及18套嘉年華服裝。周日下午2時30分在維多利亞公園開始的壓軸遊行，則有十隻四米高巨型木偶及約500名青年表演者。
入場免費。香港旅遊發展局已將活動列入本周末重點項目。
